senses.gloss:
ITA-9.5.25 ropaṇa-āścyotanam रोपण-आश्च्योतनम्
Instillation of eye drops for healing effect
The instillation of liquid medications in the eye for healing effect.

ITA-9.6.117 ropaṇakarma रोपणकर्म
Wound-healing measures
Wound-healing procedures using medications.

ITA-9.5.90 ropaṇakavalaḥ रोपणकवलः
Mouth gargle with healing property
A type of gargle with healing properties.

ITA-9.5.85 ropaṇagaṇḍūṣaḥ रोपणगण्डू षः
Retention of medications with healing property in the oral cavity
Full mouth retention of liquid medications with ulcer-healing properties for a specific time.

ITA-9.5.17 ropaṇapuṭapākaḥ रोपणपुटपाकः
Retention of heat extract bolus with healing effects
A therapeutic procedure in which an herbal extract expressed from indirectly heated bolus is retained over the eyes for a stipulated period for healing effect.

ITA-9.5.21 ropaṇasekaḥ रोपणसेकः
Continuous streaming of liquid medicines over the eyes for healing effects
A procedure involving gentle pouring of a thin stream of medicated solution over the closed eyelids for a stipulated period for healing effect.

ITA-9.5.29 ropaṇāñjanam रोपणाञ्जनम्
Collyrium with healing effect
A type of collyrium with healing effect.

ITA-5.76.184 ropaṇāñjana-atiyogaḥ रोपणाञ्जन-अतियोगः
Condition due to overdosage of healing collyrium

ITA-5.76.182 ropaṇāñjana-apacāraḥ रोपणाञ्जन-अपचारः
Condition due to improper application of healing collyrium

ITA-5.76.183 ropaṇāñjana-ayogaḥ रोपणाञ्जन-अयोगः
Condition due to underdosage of healing collyrium
A condition characterized by no desired effect following the administration of healing collyrium.
